back: Goods returned to the business by customers (sales returns).
Goods returned by the business to its suppliers (purchases returns).
A document issued by the seller showing the buyer's account has been reduced, e.g. for goods returned.
Credit each customer; debit returns inwards with the total.
Debit each supplier; credit returns outwards with the total.

front: Returns inwards in the income statement
back: Deducted from sales (revenue) in the trading section.

front: Returns outwards in the income statement
back: Deducted from purchases in the cost of sales calculation.

front: At what value are returns recorded?
back: At the net price charged on the invoice, i.e. after trade discount.
A document a buyer sends to a supplier with returned goods, asking for the account to be reduced.
